definitions.explanation: Focused on defense rather than offense; intended to protect against attack or criticism.

examples.japanese: {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}して→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He became defensive in response to criticism.

examples.japanese: {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: They approached the match with a defensive strategy.

notes:
FORMS:
- {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun (adnominal)
- {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbially)
- {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (predicative)
⟦{防御|ぼうぎょ}→防御：14575_bougyo⟧ (defense, protection) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-like, -ic)

USAGE:
Covers both physical defense and the psychological sense of guarding oneself against criticism:
- {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (defensive attitude)
- {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (defensive driving)
- {防御的|ぼうぎょてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ (defensive reaction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{攻撃的|こうげきてき}→攻撃的：06243_kougekiteki⟧ - aggressive, offensive (antonym)
- ⟦{守備的|しゅびてき}→守備的：29431_shubiteki⟧ - defensive in sports; used of formations and play, where {防御的|ぼうぎょてき} is the broader word
